CMakeLists.txt:
- Build system contract: requires CMake>=3.10. Sets CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17 and CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF. Builds static or object library downloader_core from exactly src/Url.cpp, src/SafeNamer.cpp, src/Transfer.cpp, src/DownloadQueue.cpp. target_include_directories(downloader_core PUBLIC ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include). Builds downloader_app from src/Main.cpp and links downloader_core. Builds downloader_tests from tests/test_main.cpp and links downloader_core. Calls enable_testing() and add_test(NAME downloader_tests COMMAND downloader_tests).

include/DownloadTypes.h:
- enum class Format { MP4, WEBM, AUDIO }.
- enum class DownloadState { QUEUED, DOWNLOADING, COMPLETED, CANCELED, FAILED }.
- struct Progress { std::size_t bytes; std::size_t total; }.
- struct DownloadItem { std::uint64_t id; std::string url; Format format; std::string filename; DownloadState state; Progress progress; std::string error; }.
- struct EnqueueResult { bool ok; std::uint64_t id; std::string filename; std::string error; }.
Contract: header is self-contained; includes <cstddef>, <cstdint>, <string> only. No functions are defined here. Format is defined before DownloadItem.

include/Url.h:
- Direct includes: <string> and "DownloadTypes.h".
- bool is_valid_url(const std::string& url): returns true if and only if url contains no whitespace, contains the literal separator "://", scheme before it is exactly "http" or "https", host begins at sep+3, the next slash or end marks host_end, and host_end>host_begin (i.e., non-empty host). Path is optional. Therefore, "https://example.com" and "https://example.com/clip" are valid; "https://" and "http:///path" are invalid.
- bool parse_format(const std::string& text, Format& out): case-insensitive mapping of "mp4"->Format::MP4, "webm"->Format::WEBM, "audio"->Format::AUDIO; returns true and sets out on success, false otherwise without modifying any external state.
- std::string extension_for(Format fmt): returns file extension mapping: MP4->".mp4", WEBM->".webm", AUDIO->".mp3".
Include direction: implementation in src/Url.cpp includes "Url.h" and <algorithm>, <cctype>.

src/Url.cpp:
- Implements is_valid_url, parse_format, extension_for per above; pure functions; no global state; deterministic.

include/SafeNamer.h:
- Direct includes: <string>, <unordered_set>, <vector>.
- class IExistingFiles { public: virtual ~IExistingFiles() = default; virtual bool exists(const std::string& name) const = 0; }.
- class InMemoryExistingFiles final : public IExistingFiles { private: std::unordered_set<std::string> names; public: explicit InMemoryExistingFiles() = default; explicit InMemoryExistingFiles(const std::vector<std::string>& initial); bool exists(const std::string& name) const override; void add(const std::string& name); }.
- std::string sanitize_base(const std::string& base): preserves [A-Za-z0-9], '-' and '_'; any other run collapsed to a single underscore; trims leading and trailing underscores; returns "download" if the result is empty.
- std::string unique_name(const std::string& base, const std::string& extension, const IExistingFiles& files, const std::unordered_set<std::string>& reserved): constructs candidate = base+extension; if files.exists(candidate) or candidate is in reserved, tries base_2+extension, base_3+extension, ... until neither files nor reserved contains it; returns the chosen name.
Contract: Empty InMemoryExistingFiles must be constructed via literal `InMemoryExistingFiles files;`; the form `InMemoryExistingFiles files({});` is forbidden due to ambiguity.

src/SafeNamer.cpp:
- Direct includes: "SafeNamer.h", <algorithm>, <cctype>, <utility> (before std::move).
- Implements InMemoryExistingFiles(const std::vector<std::string>& initial) by populating names; exists() by querying names; add() by inserting.
- Implements sanitize_base and unique_name exactly as specified above; no filesystem calls.

include/Transfer.h:
- Direct includes: <cstddef>, <string>.
- class ITransferAdapter { public: virtual ~ITransferAdapter() = default; virtual std::size_t total_bytes(const std::string& url) const = 0; }.
- class FakeTransferAdapter final : public ITransferAdapter { public: explicit FakeTransferAdapter(std::size_t total_bytes = 12); std::size_t total_bytes(const std::string& url) const override; private: std::size_t fixed_total_; }.
Contract: The adapter returns a fixed total byte count for any URL. There are no session APIs or bytesTransferred accessors.

src/Transfer.cpp:
- Direct includes: "Transfer.h", <stdexcept>.
- FakeTransferAdapter::FakeTransferAdapter validates that the provided total is > 0; otherwise throws std::invalid_argument.
- FakeTransferAdapter::total_bytes returns fixed_total_.

include/DownloadQueue.h:
- Direct includes: <cstddef>, <cstdint>, <string>, <unordered_set>, <vector>, plus "DownloadTypes.h", "SafeNamer.h", and "Transfer.h".
- class DownloadQueue { private: ITransferAdapter& adapter_; const IExistingFiles& files_; std::vector<DownloadItem> items_; std::unordered_set<std::string> reserved_names_; std::uint64_t next_id_ = 1; std::size_t chunk_size_; public: DownloadQueue(ITransferAdapter& adapter, const IExistingFiles& files, std::size_t chunk_size = 4); EnqueueResult enqueue(const std::string& url, const std::string& format_text, const std::string& desired_base); bool cancel(std::uint64_t id); const DownloadItem* get(std::uint64_t id) const; std::vector<DownloadItem> list() const; void tick(); }.
Semantics:
- enqueue: validates URL via is_valid_url and format via parse_format; on failure returns {ok=false, id=0, filename="", error="invalid url" or "invalid format"} and does not mutate state. On success, computes base = sanitize_base(desired_base); ext = extension_for(format); candidate = unique_name(base, ext, files_, reserved_names_); reserves candidate by inserting into reserved_names_; total = adapter_.total_bytes(url); appends DownloadItem { id=next_id_, url, format, filename=candidate, state=DownloadState::QUEUED, progress={0,total}, error="" }; increments next_id_; returns {ok=true, id, filename, error=""}.
- tick: processes at most one item per call: the first item with state QUEUED or DOWNLOADING (skipping any CANCELED/COMPLETED/FAILED). If QUEUED, transitions to DOWNLOADING. Then advances progress.bytes by min(chunk_size_, total - bytes). If bytes == total, sets state to COMPLETED. Deterministic; no randomness or time.
- cancel(id): finds item by id; if not found or already terminal (COMPLETED/CANCELED/FAILED), returns false; otherwise sets state=CANCELED and returns true. Canceled items do not advance on subsequent ticks.
- get(id) const: returns a pointer to the internal DownloadItem or nullptr if absent. Callers must treat it as read-only; invalidated by future vector reallocation if the queue mutates.
- list() const: returns a defensive copy of items_.
Include direction: src/DownloadQueue.cpp must include "DownloadQueue.h" and "Url.h" (no transitive assumptions), then <algorithm>, <stdexcept>.

src/DownloadQueue.cpp:
- Implements constructor storing references and chunk_size_. Implements enqueue, tick, cancel, get, and list per above; mutates item.progress.bytes directly by min(chunk_size_, total-bytes).

src/Main.cpp:
- Minimal runtime demo: `InMemoryExistingFiles files;` (literal zero-arg). `FakeTransferAdapter adapter;` `DownloadQueue queue(adapter, files, 4);` Enqueues one fixed HTTPS URL with format "mp4" and base "clip"; ticks a bounded number (e.g., 4) and exits 0. No IO/network/sleep.

tests/test_main.cpp:
- Includes only <cassert>, <vector>, "DownloadQueue.h", and "Url.h". Defines exactly one int main() containing four independent blocks: (a) URL/format rules, (b) Safe naming uniqueness clip->clip_2.mp4 when clip.mp4 exists, (c) Deterministic progress 0->4->8->12 and COMPLETED, (d) Cancellation freezes progress. Empty InMemoryExistingFiles instances are declared as literal zero-arg `InMemoryExistingFiles files;`.

Allowed include directions:
- Headers are self-contained. Implementation files include their paired headers and the standard headers they use. DownloadQueue.cpp must directly include "Url.h" before calling any URL API. SafeNamer.cpp must include <utility> before std::move. Tests include only headers, never src/*.cpp.

Error behavior:
- FakeTransferAdapter constructor throws std::invalid_argument if constructed with total_bytes == 0. URL parsing functions never throw; they return booleans or strings. DownloadQueue APIs never throw for normal operation; enqueue returns ok=false on invalid inputs.
